_comment: Boards driven by the scheduled discovery workflow (discovery.yml). Each entry is POSTed as one target to /api/v2/discovery/run-batch. 'source' must be one of GREENHOUSE / LEVER / ASHBY; 'identifier' is the board token/company slug used by that ATS's public API; 'company_name' is an optional display name. These are illustrative public boards - replace them with the companies you actually want to track.
